beats.headline: What's a ghillie suit?
beats.text: Mordecai warns Donut off any deity-themed class this floor. She turns down the Consecrated Enchantress and the Halloween Aficionado, then gasps at one that comes with a hat, and something else: what's a ghillie suit? Muddy, she tells Carl what she picked: a long-range sniper and assassin class, every spell's range quadrupled, invisibility at will, and it comes with a hat and a ghoulie suit. Deathbed Hellcat, Carl says. And it's ghillie suit. Mordecai had no idea; Carl knows, and keeps it a surprise.

beats.headline: Like a tassel
beats.text: Laid out on the floor, it looks to Donut like one of Signet's tattoo people fell through a paper shredder, and she will not look like a tassel. It's camouflage, Carl says; it's supposed to look like that. Long, shredded strips of colour-changing fabric blend into the background. It takes a jacket slot, yet magically covers her whole body, adding Blend into the Background and a Cone of Silence, and with the hat on too, everything is buffed further. Crupper, cloak and suit can all be worn at once.

beats.headline: The stupid ghoulie suit
beats.text: A god is here, and Carl tells Donut to get out of the Nest tower. She can see that, she answers: he has stopped at the edge of the city, and he cannot see her anyway, because she is wearing the stupid ghoulie suit and is invisible. Carl points out that she is on top of the biggest tower on the floor, shooting magic missiles. Rosetta agrees with him. A magic missile arcs down from the tower into a crowd of ghouls.

beats.headline: She looks like a sniper
beats.text: Carl rushes into the top level of the Nest to find Donut atop her seat, dressed in her ghillie suit, leaning against the parapet with her face pressed to the invisible shield. The camouflage is a strange contrast to her tiara, which glows like a lighthouse beacon. She has no weapon, and his first thought is sniper. Aiming, aiming, she mutters, and a fiery magic missile drops a distant tower in Larracos. Not so tough with your head blown off, she growls.

beats.headline: Lifted for the needle
beats.text: Donut never agreed to a tattoo, she protests, but Edgar asks for someone to lift her camouflage suit and crupper: he needs a spot on her right flank about as big as his foot. Donut fears a scar on the outside, then agrees on condition that Carl gets a matching one. Once she agrees, the ghillie suit disappears, then the crupper, and she turns her tail toward Rosetta.

relations.note: both come with the class, and buff each other
